# DraftSignal Digital

> DraftSignal Digital is a digital growth brand of Apex Grid Engineering PLLC — part of the Apex family of businesses. It builds and runs the digital growth system for construction and design firms: search and AI-search visibility (SEO/AEO), websites, reputation operations, and lead intake and automation. DraftSignal Digital itself does not provide engineering services; engineering services are provided by Apex Grid Engineering PLLC under its own licenses.

## What DraftSignal Digital does

- Search & AI-Search Visibility (SEO / AEO): technical SEO, service and market pages, AI-search citation checks with dated evidence, and accuracy monitoring for how AI tools describe a firm.
- Websites That Close: new builds and rebuilds to a flagship standard — fast on phones, heavy with proof, structured for pursuits, with working intake.
- Reputation Operations: Google Business Profile and directory accuracy, compliant review-request workflows, monitoring and response drafting. No bought, fake, incentivized, or selectively filtered reviews.
- Lead Intake & Automation: form, call, and email intake audits and rebuilds; routing by territory, discipline, and pursuit type; automated first-response and follow-up sequences; uptime and failure monitoring.

## Pricing (published, in the open)

Monthly plans — three-month initial term, billed monthly in advance:

- Foundation — $499/month + $750 setup. Technical SEO monitoring and fixes, Google Business Profile support where eligible, 2 page optimizations per month, review-request workflow, lead-form monitoring with failure alerts, monthly performance scorecard.
- Growth Engine — $999/month + $1,500 setup. Everything in Foundation, plus 4 page and content improvements per month, AI-search citation checks, local and service-page strategy, conversion testing, CRM intake routing and follow-up sequences, weekly progress summary.
- Market Authority — $1,999/month + $3,000 setup. Everything in Growth Engine, plus 8 substantive page and content improvements per month, 2 conversion experiments per month, project portfolio development, multi-market visibility monitoring, priority technical backlog, monthly strategy review.

Website builds — separate scoped projects:

- Contractor Launch Site — $2,500 (up to 5 core pages).
- Professional Firm Site — $5,000 (up to 12 pages).
- Multi-Market Growth Site — from $9,500 (custom architecture).

## Who it serves

- General contractors
- Architects and design firms
- Modular manufacturers
- Drafting and engineering firms
- Specialty trades

Area served: United States.

## Free Construction Visibility Audit

A free six-part audit, delivered in writing within two business days: (1) technical and mobile health, (2) search visibility, (3) AI discovery, (4) Google Business Profile and listings, (5) reviews and reputation, (6) conversion and intake. Request it through the audit page on the website: https://draftsignaldigital.com/free-visibility-audit

## Honesty line

DraftSignal Digital does not guarantee rankings, AI citations, leads, or revenue — nobody honest can sell those. Subscriptions buy defined work and monitoring, reported with evidence on the cadence of the tier purchased. Work performed for companies in the Apex family is always labeled as related-brand work, never presented as external client results.
